Status: wave 338: seven HawkNET ft steps named from one --inspect-type dossier

Method.evidence: A single new NameCandidates command, --inspect-type <assembly> <type> --map <map.xml>, resolves every method of a type: its map name, accessor owners, its state machine (from AsyncStateMachineAttribute or the AsyncTaskMethodBuilder.Start<T> argument) and the MoveNext literals/callees. The seven rows were named from those literals: VerifyCouplerTypeAsync, SwitchSecurityModeAsync, WaitForRestartAndIpConnectionBreakAsync, WaitForDeviceRestartAsync, ReadIdentificationDuringNetworkConfigurationAsync, LoadToolManagedIpConfigAsync, SwitchDeviceConnectionAsync.
Method.themes: Tool change that unblocks the manual tail: what took 2-3 calls per row (stub, state machine, MoveNext, map lookup) is now one call per type. Two rows in ft stay open: 0x060004BE (SM ft/x, single literal TrySecure, needs its callees read) and 0x060004C1 (SM ft/Struct292, dossier truncated before its literals).
